_about: Field notes (release 2): a new general's first battle on the field, taught as he plays it. The staff note of FIRST COMMAND (ruling 129, look ruling 147) carried onto the general's screen: one note at a time, 30 words at most, one deed, stamped DONE when he does it, never taking the controls. Kept with the player (Saved/Campaign/field-notes.json), not the save. Words for the design director and the UI director to rule; the notes run in this order, each when its moment comes. when: setup (only while he sets out his army), fight (once the clock runs), any. aim: what the brass corners frame (begin: BEGIN THE BATTLE; pause: PAUSE; tag: one of his units' tags; bar: the tug of war; none).
label: FIELD NOTE

notes.heading: Set out your army
notes.text: The clock waits while you place your units. Drag any of them inside the brass line. A unit set down in woods starts hidden from the enemy.
notes.deed: Place one unit, or BEGIN THE BATTLE.

notes.heading: Look over the field
notes.text: W A S D, or the pointer at the screen's edge, moves your view. The wheel zooms, Q and E turn, and O looks straight down.

notes.heading: Take a unit in hand
notes.text: Click a unit's tag over the field, or its card along the bottom. Shift-click adds another; drag a box round several. TAB finds your next unit.

notes.heading: Give an order
notes.text: With units in hand, click ground to send them there, or an enemy to attack. Click twice to go at the double. Orders go by radio and take a moment.

notes.heading: Take your time
notes.text: SPACE pauses the battle, and your orders still go out. 1, 2 and 3 set the pace. Pause whenever you need to think.

notes.heading: What decides it
notes.text: Nothing here is scripted. Men and machines, training, doctrine, supply, the ground and the air above decide who breaks first. Point at a unit to see it.

notes.heading: Who gives up the field
notes.text: The bar at the top leans toward whoever is winning. Under it, HOW NEAR TO BREAKING OFF fills as each side's nerve goes. The first to fill falls back.
notes.deed: Let the battle run one minute.

closing.heading: The field is yours
closing.text: H holds a unit where it stands, R falls it back, and FILM watches the fight as a camera would. Any unit you never touch, your staff fights for you.

tips.where: the attack card, under its orders, the first time it offers FIGHT IT YOURSELF
tips.text: FIGHT IT YOURSELF puts you on the field as the general; SEND THEM IN leaves it to your generals. Either way, what each side brings decides it.
